purpose: Minimum runtime contract adding platform-class anti-underestimation and ahistorical/divergent weapon handling to combat completeness.
inputs_required: combat capability factor index/matrix for combat or operational-gate profiles
event-local combat inputs for runtime-required factors before final combat result
weapon/platform capability index and platform matrix for combat/gate profiles
explicit capability/maturity/provenance for any unindexed novel/divergent event-local weapon
steps: 1 Resolve the requested checkpoint through the current checkpoint index/graph and verify execution_valid ancestry.
2 Read TECH baseline, PREWAR baseline and branch overrides from that checkpoint; do not hard-code baseline revisions in generators.
3 Resolve the event profile and mandatory semantic state requirements against checkpoint-local state first.
4 Pull TECH entries by tags/domain and apply explicit runtime gates or conservative valid_from date inference.
5 Resolve each mandatory domain as ACTIVE / NO_RELEVANT_DELTA / NOT_YET_MATURE / UNKNOWN.
6 Merge effects by causal stage; same-intermediate effects integrate once, distinct stages may compound.
7 Apply threshold, allocation/reallocation, schedule and enemy-adaptation checks.
8 Keep provisional bands visible; do not silently convert to point estimates.
9 Emit state transitions/checkpoint delta with provenance and preserve the exact checkpoint/baseline/profile revisions used.
9a For combat/gate adjudication, load combat_resolution_support from the selected checkpoint and resolve every mandatory capability factor.

9b Keep structural execution validity separate from combat-local readiness: a handout may be generated while combat_resolution_ready=false, but final combat outcome must not be issued with silent mandatory-factor omissions.
9c Resolve mandatory platform classes independently of normal event-tag TECH selection; emit anti-underestimate rules and active capability candidates.
9d Scan indexed and runtime-declared branch-specific/ahistorical systems. Never substitute historical combat reputation for a missing capability record.
execution_blockers: mandatory domain unresolved UNKNOWN when material to result and no bounded model exists
gated TECH value used as accepted
blocked checkpoint ancestry used as current state
stale superseded execution artifact used contrary to manifest
historical outcome used directly as upstream input
event generator ignores or only relabels the requested checkpoint without consuming its baseline/state
current event profile/domain map is older than the current-version registry
later-dated TECH entry is treated as mature before its machine/date gate
combat/gate result issued without loading checkpoint combat_resolution_support
mandatory combat factor silently omitted or defaulted to neutral/zero
unindexed novel/divergent/unknown event-local weapon lacks capability record, readiness/maturity or provenance
historical analogue combat outcome substituted for a branch-specific weapon capability
non_blocking_uncertainty: provisional effect magnitude when sensitivity band can be carried
citation incompleteness that does not alter runtime state
